saveTimingMethod: Per committed command: state codec traversal plus row-state JSON mapper, part hashes, and awaited write statements with row-state JSON time removed. SQL timing includes driver/ORM overhead; excludes reads, locking and transaction commit.
engineTimingMethod: Exclusive synchronous wall milliseconds inside applyEngineCommand: PA loop, instrumented day settlements, selected validators and state copies, canonical SHA seals. Remaining engine work is residual; HTTP views are outside this boundary.
